Container.Name: Papigator
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted document archive for families. Upload or scan letters, invoices and contracts: Papigator runs OCR, makes everything full-text searchable and can use a local AI (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server) for titles, senders, dates, deadlines and tags. Web app in the browser, optional iPhone/iPad app.
First start: open the web UI, click "Ersteinrichtung" (first-run setup), enter the setup token you chose below and create the first admin. After that the token no longer works; more users are added in the settings.
Scanner: let your scanner write into inbox/USERNAME/ inside the app data folder, or map a share of your choice to the optional scanner inbox path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: documents paperless ocr archive scanner pdf invoices dms

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web app and API (also used by the iPhone/iPad app).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, PDFs, thumbnails and the scanner inbox (inbox/USERNAME/).

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Nightly snapshots (03:00). Best on the array or a second disk, not on the same pool as the app data.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Required. Any long random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 24). You enter it once in the web UI to create the first admin; it stops working as soon as a user exists.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Recommended: openssl rand -base64 32, and keep a copy in your password manager – a restored backup needs the same key for stored mail passwords and share link addresses. Empty: Papigator creates one in the app data folder (.papigator.key). Do not change it later.

Config.Name: Scanner inbox (optional)
Config.Description: Optional share your scanner writes to. Put each user's scans in a subfolder named like the Papigator username in lower case (e.g. /mnt/user/scans/alex/); scans directly in the share go to the first admin. Empty: inbox/ inside the app data folder.

Config.Name: AI server URL
Config.Description: Optional, OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. Ollama: http://UNRAID-IP:11434/v1. Empty = no AI. Can also be set later in the web app (Settings → AI recognition).

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Model name on the AI server.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Language of the texts the AI writes (titles, summaries, new tags) and of the weekly summary mail: de = German, en = English. Can also be changed later in the web app (Settings → AI recognition). The web app itself follows the browser language.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as (Unraid: 100 = users).
